reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-02: nothing dispatches this command. The Finish My Song program has been paused since 2026-08-11 (CLAUDE.md), so this is a structural hold, not a to-do: on expiry either renew, add that minimal selftest check in a native PR, or delete the command if FMS stays parked.
